message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data in this chat, so I can’t tell you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment.  
If you want up‑to‑date information you can check one of the following:

| Source | What it offers | How to use |
|--------|----------------|------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Current AQI, forecast, and health messages for stations in LA County | Go to https://www.airnow.gov/, select “California” → “Los Angeles” |
| **AQICN** (World Air Quality Index) | Global real‑time AQI, historical data, and alerts | Visit https://aqicn.org/, search “Los Angeles” |
| **Local news sites** (e.g., LA Times, KABC) | Often publish live updates during smog events | Look for “air quality” or “smog” sections |

Typical values for Los Angeles range from **Good (0–50)** to **Unhealthy (151–200)** depending on weather, traffic, and wildfire activity. If you’re planning outdoor activities, it’s safest to check the current AQI and follow any health advisories.
